input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, survey, question, todo. The platform provides capabilities for user dao, data, sort algorithm. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage survey records, so that I can track and organize survey data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage question records, so that I can track and organize question data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage todo records, so that I can track and organize todo data effectively.
